model.deltaVDescription: Independent seeded Gaussian radial, tangential and cross-track components, each sigma 21 m/s; same draws across scenarios.
model.areaMassDescription: Fixed seeded log-uniform 0.006–0.06 m²/kg; same draws across scenarios.
model.atmosphere: Fixed log-linear density versus altitude, see build_data.py; no solar or geomagnetic variation.
model.propagation: Each fragment starts on its own impulse-defined Keplerian ellipse; orbit-averaged drag changes energy and angular momentum, and secular J2 advances the node and perigee. No short-period J2, solar radiation pressure, collisions, or mass production model.
model.sampleWeight: One visual particle equals one modeled sample fragment; no scaling to a real breakup.

activeCatalog.altitudeMeasure: Circular-equivalent altitude from GP mean motion
activeCatalog.note: CelesTrak active group is a catalog grouping; individual operational status was not independently verified. Static present-day reference, not a future forecast.
